text:
Elaine (CS): Hi team — kicking off AcmeCorp onboarding (acct: ACME-47). Quick context: they want hosted API first, then Dedicated later. Key success criteria: 1) production latencies <200ms 95th, 2) embedding similarity >=0.88 on their eval set, 3) SSO + basic audit logs. Kickoff mtg Wed 3/27 9am PT. Who owns each area?

Mike (SE): I can own integration + telemetry for the first 30 days. Will set up sample SDK flows and event tracking.

Tom (Solutions): I'll run the initial performance validation and help with model selection. Plan to try two variants: redwood/gpt-medium + quantized variant.

Sara (Ops): I'll scope VPC networking & secrets (KMS) checklist. Need tenant network CIDR and SSO SAML metadata from Acme.

Elaine (CS): Thanks. Stakeholders at Acme: Sarah Palmer (Product), Javier Rivera (Eng), Priya Anand (Legal). @Javier (Eng) — please confirm engineering attendees for the kickoff.

Javier (Eng): I'll be there. We need a short enablement session for their infra team on private deployment constraints. Prefer Tue 3/26 afternoon for pre-call sync.

Priya (Legal): FYI — Acme requires a data residency addendum and a minimum retention policy for audit logs. I'm prepping the checklist.

Onboarding Bot: Action items created: #ACME-ONB-1: Collect SAML metadata (owner: Acme/Sarah). #ACME-ONB-2: Initial perf run (owner: Tom). #ACME-ONB-3: Telemetry plan (owner: Mike). Due dates default to 7 days.

Mike (SE): Quick Q on telemetry — do we want sampling or full token-level traces for first week? Sampling will keep cost down but may miss edge cases.

Elaine (CS): Start with 10% sampling + full traces on errors and spikes. We'll increase if early regressions appear.

Tom (Solutions): Draft timeline (very rough):
```
Week 0 (3/27): Kickoff, collect access, SAML + network details
Week 1: Integration + example flows, initial perf tests
Week 2: Quantization candidate eval, cost tuning
Week 3: Pilot w/ 2 internal endpoints, enablement session
Week 4: Hand-off, runbook + SLA conversations
```

Sara (Ops): Noted. For Dedicated later we should reserve capacity window: recommend holding a buffer for their expected Q4 traffic spike.

Elaine (CS): Renewal risk note — ACME has a 6-month review clause. If pilot doesn't show 30% latency or cost improvements vs their current host, renewal will be at risk. We should prioritize quick wins (prefix caching, batching).

Mike (SE): I'll add caching + batching config as part of perf tests. Can we get their sequence length distribution? that'll affect batching behavior.

Javier (Eng): Sharing sample payloads and token stats after this message.

Priya (Legal): Also need a list of sub-processors for their compliance team. I'll share template.

Elaine (CS): Perfect. Can everyone reply with a single-line confirmation of ownership? I'll compile the plan and send calendar invites.

Tom (Solutions): Tom — owns perf validation. Confirmed.

Mike (SE): Mike — owns integration & telemetry. Confirmed.

Sara (Ops): Sara — owns VPC/KMS & infra checklist. Confirmed.

Javier (Eng): Javier — Eng point, will provide payloads. Confirmed.

Priya (Legal): Priya — legal/compliance. Confirmed.

Onboarding Bot: Reminder scheduled: Kickoff meeting 2024-03-27 16:00 UTC. Checklist link: https://redwood.company/onboard/ACME-47/checklist

Elaine (CS): Thanks all. I'll post a short one-page success criteria doc and the pre-kickoff checklist by EOD today. :thumbsup:
